description:
Alara is a high school senior interested in computer vision, robotics and space technology. 

Ranjitha is a lawyer and human-centered design engineer whose published research explores HCI and AI safety in high-stakes professions. She translates research, legal insight, and responsible design into practical tools for safer, more human-centered technology.

Maju works to increase equitable practices in organizations and increase collaboration amongst stakeholders in the global social impact space.
